text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand and work with human language. One of its main goals is text understanding, which means teaching machines to grasp the meaning of written words, not just read them as symbols. NLP powers many everyday tools, like automatic translation, which can change a sentence from English to French almost instantly. Another important use is sentiment analysis, where computers decide whether a product review is positive or negative. Finally, chatbots rely on NLP to hold simple conversations with people, answering common questions in a natural way. While machines still struggle with sarcasm, NLP has made huge progress.
